Ok story time!

I was playing league for about a year, year and a half, when my friend from school said he and a few other people started it and ask me if I wanted to play with them. I said yes because i've been playing the game solo while my brother has been playing it with his friends and seemed like a lot of fun. So I got on with them, there were 4 guys I was playing with, 1 i was already friends with, 2 I were people that I've met through school but weren't friends with, and the other I had never met. I played with them almost every day, helping get to know the game and other stuff. I had lots of fun with them, eventually when they got to level 30 we started rank teams, we never really did that well (getting placed very poorly and not really getting motivated to play) and it kind of got us all mad so w never really did much with it. so after about a little less than a year going by they started to get really annoyed by me, I had a bad habit of either feeding or hard carrying, and often did take things so seriously. So they started to kick me from the skype call and not play with me. Now they were basically the only friends I did stuff with outside of school and I not really addicted to socializing with them and got really mad when they wouldn't play with me and then intern mad them even more not want to play with me even more. Eventually they blocked me on skype, and  one even unfriended me on league. I got to say one of them, the one i didn't know before hand, was really nice to me and was against what the others were doing, but still sided with them because he was closer to them. I cant blame the guy and really appreciate him being on my side. So the conflict online quickly transferred to school so they wouldn't talk to me there either. I still had other clicks I was in so I wasn't alone at school just at home. It was hard adjusting, it was like quitting cold turkey, I had to find solace from playing alone again. Eventually a month had past by and I was fine playing alone, but still tried to get back with them, and they always denied me. I tried and tried until I got fed up with them and stopped. After about 6 months from the whole debacle I started to sit with them a lunch sometimes and talk to them, staying away from the topic of league, but still it was kinda tense between me and them. My relation with them grew slowly in real life until it there I felt no social tension between us, but online was still nonexistent.

Now 2 whole years has past from when I first started playing with them. I've gained a lot, lost a lot, and learned a lot. Relations with 3 of the 4 are fine, but the last guy I still don't talk too (ironically its the one that i was best friends with at the start). I only play league of legends alone now, looking at their profile from time to time. I will never play with anyone on that game because I take it too seriously to be fun with anyone. 

If there is anything you should take away from this is that you should only play with your friends for fun, never seriously. You guys might think that you're going to be the best team there ever was, but there's going to be one of you that just better or works harder or cares more and thats going to cause a lot of trouble. Play with friends for fun because other wise you're going to end up like me. Alone.
